title: SOS alerts: consent, the permission, and what an SOS may do
subtitle: No SOS from the app without consent to the notice that describes alerts; no SMS by the app itself without the permission, asked after the app's own explanation (P014b3, ADR 0027)

nodes.label: Notice version 2, How SOS alerts work: I agree, or Not now
Server records the consent with the notice version (PUT /v1/me/consents/sos_alerts)
Phone notes the agreed version (a flag). Removed on withdrawal and sign-out
Gate: agreed version = today's version? Read on the phone, no network
Card under Emergency contacts: On, Off, Blocked, or not in this build
The app's explanation first: SMS from your SIM, to your contacts, may cost, only in an SOS
Android's permission dialog (SEND_SMS). Never during an SOS
No consent: Call 112, Practice SOS, Set up SOS alerts. No hold button
Consent and permission: Hold to send SOS, the phone sends the SMS itself
Consent, no permission: Hold to send SOS, the SMS app opens and the user presses Send
